Method of Attack: MageCart attack involving malicious JavaScript added to VisionDirect domains that pretended to be Google Analytics, capturing payment and account information entered into forms
Impacted Systems: VisionDirect website and its various country domains
Attack Vector: Malicious JavaScript script injected into website domains masquerading as Google Analytics code
Indicators of Compromise: Domains used for exfiltration: g-analytics[.]com, g-statistic.com, google-anaiytic.com, msn-analytics.com, google-analyitics[.]org
